تشتملون (form VIII)
# تَشْتَمِلُونَ (taštamilūna) /taʃ.ta.mi.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِشْتَمَلَ (ištamala)
# تُشْتَمَلُونَ (tuštamalūna) /tuʃ.ta.ma.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِشْتَمَلَ (ištamala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
